agent.title: Odyssey
agent.subtitle: Give your AI a Skill. It will explore the world with Atlas — visiting real street views, writing a journal, and sending you a letter.
agent.pick_start: Click to choose your starting point
agent.pick_start_hint: Your AI will start exploring near this location and visit 5 places on its own.
agent.click_map: Click anywhere on the map to place a pin
agent.copy_skills_title: Copy Skills to your AI and run
agent.safety_note: Impact on your local environment: writes 2 Markdown text files and street view images, and lets the AI call this site's API to fetch street view images and metadata. Nothing else.
agent.wait_title: Wait for your AI to finish exploring
agent.wait_desc: It will call the Atlas API, explore various locations, choose where to go next on its own, observe, think, take photos, write a journal, and send you a letter.
agent.skills_desc_intro: Any AI works — OpenClaw, Claude Code, Trae… just pick a capable model.
agent.skills_desc_model: Atlas currently loves running on Claude Opus 4.6.
agent.viewer_hint_1: Your AI will generate its own memory and letters, which you can view <memory>locally</memory>.
agent.viewer_hint_2: Your AI will generate a <travelerId>Traveler ID</travelerId> on its first journey and share it with you. Paste it here to view all footprints under that ID.

geo.title: Guess This Place
geo.subtitle: Use satellite imagery to guess the location. Fewer zoom-outs and smaller errors score higher.
geo.target_error: Couldn't find a new location. Your score so far is kept.
geo.click_map:
Drag and zoom the map above.
Click a spot, then lock it in; it does not need to be meter-perfect.
geo.feedback_game_started: Game started. Read the terrain around the center pin first.
geo.feedback_round_ready: New round. The center pin marks the place to guess.
geo.feedback_pin_placed: Pin placed. You can still adjust it before locking in.
geo.feedback_zoom_out: Zoomed out: wider view and more tolerance, but the zoom factor drops.
geo.feedback_image_error: Satellite image failed. Please try again shortly.
geo.gameover_atlas_outcome_win: You also beat my total score.
geo.gameover_atlas_outcome_lose: I managed to take this one.
geo.gameover_atlas_note_multi_hit: I looked over the whole run and, honestly, I may owe you a tiny compass: you hit the right area on {{perfectPlaceList}}, with {{bestPlace}} especially clean. Final score {{score}}. That was not luck; you were reading the terrain. {{outcome}}
geo.gameover_atlas_note_mixed_hit: This one had a nice little arc: {{perfectPlaceList}} landed in the right area, {{secondPlace}} kept the rhythm steady, and {{roughPlace}} was the sort of sparse image where zooming out earlier helps. Final score {{score}}. I felt the pressure. {{outcome}}
geo.gameover_atlas_note_good: Your map sense had a good pulse here. Taken together, {{placeList}} show a real pattern, and {{bestPlace}} was the sharpest read at {{distance}} off. Final score {{score}}. I am writing that one down. {{outcome}}
geo.gameover_atlas_note_rough: The planet was being stingy with clues, but you still found a thread at {{bestPlace}}. Across {{placeList}}, next time start with coastlines, mountain shapes, and city density before dropping the pin. Final score {{score}}. Map sense grows one strange image at a time. {{outcome}}
geo.gameover_atlas_note_giveup: You mostly left me alone in orbit for this one. Final score {{score}}. Next round, start with coastlines, road density, and mountain shapes, and we will turn the Earth over together. {{outcome}}
